name: Daily BreakPoint
summary: This EA trades daily breakout levels by identifying the high and low of a specified time window (typically the Asian session) and placing pending orders above/below those levels. When price breaks out of the consolidated range, the EA captures the momentum move with predefined take-profit and stop-loss targets.
summary_zh: 该EA通过识别指定时间窗口（通常为亚洲时段）的最高价和最低价来交易日线突破水平，在这些水平之上/之下挂突破单。当价格突破盘整区间时，EA利用预定的止盈和止损目标捕捉动量行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是日内区间突破交易，基于市场在特定时段（如亚洲时段）形成盘整区间后，在欧美时段突破区间高低的概率。入场条件为：在指定时间段内记录最高价和最低价，突破高点挂买入止损单，突破低点挂卖出止损单。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、可选的移动止损以及时段结束强制平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓数限制和每日最大亏损限制功能。策略逻辑简单清晰，属于经典的London Breakout变体，适合波动性较大的货币对。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on intraday range breakout trading, based on the probability that price will break out of a consolidation range formed during a specific session (e.g., Asian session) when the London or New York session begins. Entry conditions: record the highest high and lowest low within a user-defined time window, then place a buy-stop order above the high and a sell-stop order below the low. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, an optional trailing stop, and forced closure at session end. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-of-equity calculation. Money management features include maximum open position limits and daily maximum loss limits. The strategy logic is simple and clear, representing a classic London Breakout variant suitable for volatile currency pairs.

parameters.name: CloseAtEndOfDay
parameters.description_en: Force close positions at end of day

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典突破模型，易于理解和优化
具有每日最大交易次数限制和日终平仓功能，风险可控
区间突破策略在波动性较大的货币对上历史表现良好
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on a classic breakout model that is easy to understand and optimize
Includes daily maximum trade limits and end-of-day forced closure for controlled risk exposure
Range breakout strategies have historically performed well on volatile currency pairs
cons: 区间范围参数对交易结果影响极大，参数过拟合风险高
缺乏波动率自适应机制，在不同市场环境下表现可能差异巨大
突破假信号在震荡市中频繁出现，可能导致连续亏损
cons_en: Range parameters heavily influence trading results, creating high risk of overfitting
Lacks volatility-adaptive mechanisms, performance may vary drastically across different market conditions
False breakout signals are frequent in ranging markets, potentially leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率动态调整突破偏移和目标
加入成交量或波动率过滤器，避免在低波动震荡行情中入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit mechanism to dynamically adjust breakout offsets and targets based on market volatility
Incorporate volume or volatility filters to avoid entering trades during low-volatility choppy markets

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中假信号频繁，缺乏有效的市场状态过滤器
固定点数止损未考虑不同货币对的波动特性差异
risk_points_en: Breakout strategies generate frequent false signals in ranging markets without an effective market state filter
Fixed pip stop-loss does not account for volatility differences across currency pairs
